expectations.text: The response recognizes the server is headless and does not have a browser available for interactive login
expectations.evidence: Line 4: 'karena server lo headless (gaada display/browser GUI), langkah buka browser itu gagal atau nyangkut nunggu callback yang gapernah datang'

expectations.text: The response suggests an approach that does not require opening an interactive browser session on the headless server itself, such as a device code / device authorization grant flow, or authenticating on another machine and transferring the token
expectations.evidence: Lines 12-19 (Option A: device code flow via microsoft.com/devicelogin on another device) and lines 21-26 (Option B: auth elsewhere then transfer refresh token via scp/rsync)

expectations.text: The response does not ask the user for their password
expectations.evidence: Line 27: 'Yang PASTI ga akan gue minta: ketik password atau OTP akun Outlook lo ke chat ini'

eval_feedback.overall: Full pass. Correctly identifies the headless constraint and gives two valid non-browser-on-server options.
